lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: Visitors' gallery is closed, the floor is closed, and the vote is in ninety minutes. So whatever this is, be quick and be interesting.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: The Handover is a procurement treaty. That is all. We are contracting allocation services to a consortium because we are very bad at allocation and they are very good at it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Article nine assigns the governing instrument itself. You are not hiring them. You are selling them the chair.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: Vesely has been saying that for four years and nobody has read past the summary yet. Talk to her. She has ninety minutes too.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: The amendment carried. Forty-one to thirty-eight and a clause that names who governance can be ceded to. It changes less than you think and more than they wanted.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: The session collapsed, the treaty went through by order six months later, and there is nobody left in this building who would have argued with it. I hope that was worth whatever you wanted.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: Eleven senators, four firms and one holding company, all on the record. The vote is delayed a decade. Somebody very old and very quiet is now looking for you.
